<!-- Generated by Kora's design director. This is the design decision the site was built
     from. Business: Frankie & Fanucci's -->

# DESIGN.md — Frankie & Fanucci's

archetype: warm-trattoria
rationale: Frankie & Fanucci's is exactly the neighbourhood Italian that warm-trattoria was built for — a bustling, family-friendly Mamaroneck pizzeria with six "Best of Westchester" wins, a wood-fired oven at its heart, and a menu that runs from Nonna's Meatballs to Truffled Spaghetti; the warm, unpretentious energy of the room earns a palette and type treatment that feels like a neighbourhood institution, not a delivery app.
interaction_level: L2

personality: [energetic, warm, neighbourhood, proudly Italian]

typography:
  display: "Freight Big Pro"
  body: "Georgia, serif — fallback to system-ui for body paragraphs; nav and labels in a clean humanist sans (Inter or system-ui)"
  scale: 1.25
  notes: "H1 at ~4rem, H2 at ~2.5rem, H3 at ~1.6rem, body at 1rem/1.6 leading. Category eyebrows on the menu set in small-caps Inter at 0.75rem, letter-spaced 0.12em. The display face (Freight Big Pro) carries all headings; body copy and nav labels stay in the sans. The award badge ('Voted Best of Westchester 6×') is set in Freight Big Pro italic at 1.1rem."

palette:
  primary: "#1c1c1a"
  secondary: "#f4f0e6"
  accent: "#b33a2b"
  application: "Page ground is #f4f0e6 (secondary). Header and footer carry #1c1c1a (primary) as a deep near-black band. Section alternation: food-forward sections sit on the warm #f4f0e6 ground; the story band and the hours/location band use a slightly deeper tint (#ede8d8) to break rhythm without introducing a third colour. Accent #b33a2b appears on: the 'Order Online' CTA button, hairline rules beneath category eyebrows on the menu, the award badge, and the happy-hour callout — nowhere else."

composition:
  whitespace: balanced
  photography: supporting
  card_usage: minimal
  mobile: "Header collapses to logo left / hamburger right; nav opens as a full-height dark drawer (#1c1c1a) with nav items stacked at 1.5rem in Freight Big Pro, 'Order Online' as an accent button at the base of the drawer. Hero image crops to 16:9 above the text block rather than behind it. Menu switches to a single column with category eyebrows as full-width dividers. The gallery filmstrip becomes a single-column vertical stack of three images. Hours/location stacks address above hours, no side-by-side columns. Footer stacks into a single centred column."

shell:
  header: >
    Fixed-height band, 64px tall, horizontal padding 2rem each side. Background #1c1c1a. Sticky — on scroll past 80px the band gains a 2px bottom border in #b33a2b and reduces to 56px with a 200ms ease transition; the logo and nav scale proportionally. Left: the circular logo image (https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5b021e482714e5923e6df0ff/3e38ec41-716b-48c9-93e0-5dc3d1db98d8/FF+Circle+BlackBG.jpg) at 44px diameter, followed by the wordmark "Frankie & Fanucci's" in Freight Big Pro at 1.1rem, colour #f4f0e6, normal weight — no text-transform, no letter-spacing beyond the font's own. Centre: nav links (see nav list below) in Inter at 0.8rem, colour #f4f0e6 at 80% opacity, uppercase, letter-spaced 0.08em — active page link at 100% opacity with a 1px underline in #b33a2b. Right: a single CTA button labelled "Order Online" in Inter 0.8rem uppercase, background #b33a2b, colour #f4f0e6, padding 0.5rem 1.2rem, no border-radius (square corners), linking to https://order.toasttab.com/online/fandfpizza. Mobile: logo + wordmark left, hamburger icon right (three 18px lines in #f4f0e6, 2px stroke), no nav visible, no CTA button visible — both appear inside the drawer.
  nav:
    - "Home"
    - "Menu"
    - "Catering"
    - "Groups"
    - "Happy Hour"
    - "Delivery"
    - "Rewards"
  footer: >
    Full-width band, background #1c1c1a, colour #f4f0e6, padding 3rem 2rem 2rem. Three-column grid on desktop (each column left-aligned), single centred column on mobile with 1.5rem gap between groups.

    Column 1 — Identity:
    Logo image at 52px diameter above the wordmark "Frankie & Fanucci's" in Freight Big Pro at 1.2rem, colour #f4f0e6. One line below: the tagline "Bustling pizzeria serving Neapolitan thin-crust pies, pasta & other fare in a casual environment." in Inter at 0.8rem, colour #f4f0e6 at 65% opacity, max-width 22ch.

    Column 2 — Visit Us (label "VISIT US" in Inter small-caps 0.7rem letter-spaced 0.1em, colour #b33a2b, above a 1px rule in #b33a2b at 40% opacity):
    Address block set as:
      "301 Mamaroneck Ave"
      "Mamaroneck, New York 10543"
    in Inter 0.875rem, colour #f4f0e6, line-height 1.6. Then the phone number "(914) 630-4360" as a tappable <a href="tel:+19146304360"> in Inter 1rem, colour #f4f0e6, font-weight 600 — this is the one accent-adjacent moment in the footer (no accent colour on it; weight alone distinguishes it).

    Column 3 — Hours (label "HOURS" in Inter small-caps 0.7rem letter-spaced 0.1em, colour #b33a2b, above a 1px rule in #b33a2b at 40% opacity):
    Hours set as an aligned two-column day/time pair list in Inter 0.875rem, colour #f4f0e6:
      "Mon – Thu" · "12 pm – 9 pm"
      "Fri – Sat" · "12 pm – 10 pm"
      "Sunday" · "12 pm – 9 pm"
    Day labels at normal weight; times at normal weight; a tab or flex gap of 1.5rem between columns. No separators between rows.

    Below all three columns, a full-width hairline rule in #f4f0e6 at 20% opacity, then a single closing line in Inter 0.75rem at 50% opacity: "© Frankie & Fanucci's · Mamaroneck, NY" — left-aligned on desktop, centred on mobile. No nav repeat. No social links (none available).

    intent: "What can I order, and what's in it?"
    takes: [offerings]

sections:
  - id: hero
    layout: full-bleed-image
    show: all
    spec: >
      Full-bleed photograph (https://deveusblob.blob.core.windows.net/kora-business-images/user-media/6b2b62af-58a9-483f-8461-c3c86b05fd49/10ba98a4-a410-4015-99d9-701074e2e5bc/1788952875_6k0aaq.webp) edge to edge, minimum 85vh tall. A dark gradient overlay runs from transparent at the top to #1c1c1a at 75% opacity across the lower 55% of the image. All text sits in the lower-left third of the frame. H1 "Frankie & Fanucci's" in Freight Big Pro at 4.5rem, colour #f4f0e6, no text-transform. Immediately below: the subtitle "Neapolitan thin-crust pies, pasta & more." in Freight Big Pro italic at 1.6rem, colour #f4f0e6 at 85% opacity. Below that, one line in Inter 0.8rem small-caps letter-spaced 0.1em, colour #f4f0e6 at 65%: "Voted Best of Westchester 6×". Then two inline elements: the "Order Online" button (accent #b33a2b, square corners, Inter 0.85rem uppercase, padding 0.75rem 1.75rem) and a plain text link "View Menu →" in Inter 0.85rem, colour #f4f0e6, with a 1px underline, linking to menu.html — 1.5rem gap between them. On mobile the image crops to 16:9 above the text block (text sits below on the #f4f0e6 ground), headline drops to 2.5rem, subtitle to 1.2rem.

  - id: story
    layout: quote-led
    show: all
    spec: >
      Full-width section on the #ede8d8 tinted ground, padding 5rem 2rem. A single oversized pulled quote — "Award-winning thin-crust pies, baked in a wood-fired oven. Voted Best of Westchester six times." — set in Freight Big Pro italic at 2.2rem, colour #1c1c1a, max-width 28ch, centred on the column. A 2px rule in #b33a2b, 3rem wide, sits above the quote. Below the quote, the full about paragraph in Inter at 1rem, colour #1c1c1a at 80% opacity, max-width 60ch, centred. No images in this section — the photography is doing its work in the hero and gallery. On mobile the quote drops to 1.5rem and the measure widens to full column.

  - id: offerings
    layout: editorial-list
    show: "5 of 156, chosen for range, links to menu.html"
    spec: >
      Section on the #f4f0e6 ground, padding 4rem 2rem. Section heading "Menu" in Freight Big Pro at 2.5rem, left-aligned, with the eyebrow "wood-fired · scratch made · fresh" in Inter small-caps 0.75rem letter-spaced 0.12em, colour #b33a2b, above it. Show five signature items representing the range — one pizza (AMICI: meatball, sausage, pepperoni, mozzarella, sauce), one pasta (LASAGNA: layers of fresh pasta, bolognese meat sauce, ricotta, fresh mozzarella), one antipasto (NONNA'S MEATBALLS: fresh brooklyn ricotta, tuscan bread), one hero sandwich (CAPRESE: fresh mozzarella, roasted peppers, tomato, prosciutto, basil, arugula, balsamic & oil), and one dessert (BOMBOLONI: nutella stuffed donut holes, cinnamon-sugar) — displayed as a two-column list on desktop, one column on mobile. Each row: item name in Inter 0.95rem font-weight 600 uppercase, colour #1c1c1a; description in Inter 0.875rem, colour #1c1c1a at 65%, on the line below; a full-width hairline rule in #1c1c1a at 12% opacity beneath each item. No images, no cards, no borders around rows. Below the list, a centred link "See the full menu →" in Freight Big Pro italic 1.1rem, colour #b33a2b, linking to menu.html.

  - id: offers
    layout: editorial-split
    show: all
    spec: >
      A #1c1c1a full-width band, padding 4rem 2rem. Two items side by side on desktop, stacked on mobile, separated by a single 1px vertical rule in #f4f0e6 at 20% opacity (hidden on mobile). Left panel: the Happy Hour offer — eyebrow "ALL DAY · EVERY DAY · AT THE BAR" in Inter small-caps 0.7rem letter-spaced 0.12em, colour #b33a2b; heading "2 for 1 Happy Hour" in Freight Big Pro 2.2rem, colour #f4f0e6; subline "See full bar menu →" as a plain link to happyhour.html in Inter 0.875rem, colour #f4f0e6 at 70%. Right panel: the Meal Deal — eyebrow "TAKE-OUT & DELIVERY" in Inter small-caps 0.7rem, colour #b33a2b; heading "$35.95 Meal Deal" in Freight Big Pro 2.2rem, colour #f4f0e6; description "Large Margherita + Tuscan or Caesar salad + old school garlic bread. Limited 1 per order." in Inter 0.875rem, colour #f4f0e6 at 70%; one "Order Online" button in #b33a2b linking to https://order.toasttab.com/online/fandfpizza. No images, no cards — colour contrast does all the structural work.

  - id: gallery
    layout: filmstrip
    show: "6 of 8, links to nothing"
    spec: >
      A horizontal filmstrip band on the #f4f0e6 ground, no padding top or bottom — the images sit flush. Six images in a row, each 340px wide and 260px tall (fixed, not variable), cropped to fill with object-fit: cover, no border-radius, no gap between images. The strip overflows its container and is scrollable on mobile with momentum scrolling; on desktop all six are visible at 1280px and wider, with the rightmost image cropping at the edge below that. Images in order: 1788952880_g21phe.webp, 1788952884_rnqgw3.webp, 1788952885_3li9sc.webp, 1788952887_sd5igx.webp, 1788952891_b0bynb.webp, 1788952893_upki5z.webp. No captions, no overlays, no controls.

  - id: hours_location
    layout: stacked-band
    show: all
    spec: >
      Full-width band on #ede8d8, padding 4rem 2rem. Two columns on desktop (each 50% width), stacked on mobile. Left column: section eyebrow "FIND US" in Inter small-caps 0.7rem letter-spaced 0.1em, colour #b33a2b, then a 1px rule in #b33a2b at 40% opacity. Address set as a real address block in Freight Big Pro at 1.4rem, colour #1c1c1a, line-height 1.4:
        "301 Mamaroneck Ave"
        "Mamaroneck, New York 10543"
      Below: phone as a tappable link "(914) 630-4360" in Inter 1.1rem font-weight 600, colour #1c1c1a, href="tel:+19146304360". Below that: a plain text link "Get Directions →" in Inter 0.875rem, colour #b33a2b, href="https://www.google.com/search?q=frankie+and+fanuccis+directions". Right column: section eyebrow "HOURS" in Inter small-caps 0.7rem letter-spaced 0.1em, colour #b33a2b, then a 1px rule. Hours as an aligned day/time pair list in Inter 0.95rem, colour #1c1c1a, using a flex row with space-between:
        "Mon – Thu" / "12 pm – 9 pm"
        "Fri – Sat" / "12 pm – 10 pm"
        "Sunday" / "12 pm – 9 pm"
      Below the hours, one line in Inter 0.8rem, colour #1c1c1a at 60%: "Delivery daily 12–9 pm · Dine-in · Takeout · Curbside pickup available" — this is a single line, no list. No map embed (coordinates not available).

  - id: contact
    layout: minimal-band
    show: all
    spec: >
      A closing band on #1c1c1a, padding 3rem 2rem. Single centred column. Heading "Order, Dine In, or Take Out" in Freight Big Pro 2rem, colour #f4f0e6. One line below: "Ready when you are — online or by phone." in Inter 1rem, colour #f4f0e6 at 70%. Two inline actions with 1.5rem gap: "Order Online" button (background #b33a2b, colour #f4f0e6, square corners, Inter 0.875rem uppercase, padding 0.75rem 1.75rem, href https://order.toasttab.com/online/fandfpizza) and a plain text link "(914) 630-4360" as href="tel:+19146304360" in Inter 0.875rem, colour #f4f0e6, font-weight 600. Nothing else — no form, no map, no social links.

avoid:
  - A three-column icon grid of "Fresh · Local · Handmade" or any equivalent
  - Star-rating rows or review cards (no reviews available — section omitted entirely)
  - Drop shadows on any card or image container
  - Rounded corners on images or buttons
  - A centred hero with three equal-weight cards beneath it
  - Gradient overlays other than the directional dark grade on the hero photograph
  - Chalkboard or script-font pastiche treatments
  - Any placeholder, invented review, invented price, or invented social link
  - Repeating the full navigation in the footer
  - A "Powered by" line written into the footer markup (injected by deploy pipeline)
